# Feature grid — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the feature grid when the marketing page needs its product features as cards. `items` are data — id, title, description, icon — rendered as cards under the section's `title` and `description`, and without items there is no section at all. Feature cards describe rather than link: there are no links inside, because navigation is the host's, and no icon set either, because icons arrive as nodes and the grid never picks glyphs. The grid is a labelled features region, so the cards announce as a set under the section heading.

## Native

### Features

Feature cards describe rather than link: there are no links inside, because navigation is the host's, and no icon set either, because icons arrive as nodes and the grid never picks glyphs. The grid is a labelled features region, so the cards announce as a set under the section heading.
